provenance: Deterministic synthetic RGBA marker pixels created only to exercise the F02 multi-image import pipeline; not character art and never included in runtime content.

processing.procedure: docs/agent_staging/f02-multi-family-acceptance/fixtures; encode 32x96 RGBA PNG rows with filter 0 and zlib level 9; place one opaque 4x4 marker at local pixel x=14..17,y=20..23 in each 32x48 cell; all other pixels are transparent. PNG row zero is the top row. The top PNG half is the Unity y=48 attack slice; the bottom PNG half is the Unity y=0 idle slice.
processing.parameters: BellatorFramesA: bottom PNG half (Unity Idle_A) #FF00FFFF; top PNG half (Unity Attack_A) #FFFF00FF. BellatorFramesB: bottom PNG half (Unity Idle_B) #00FFFFFF; top PNG half (Unity Attack_B) #00FF00FF. PNG bit depth 8, color type 6. This corrects the orientation wording in v1 without changing the pinned PNG bytes. These files are technical fixtures only.
